name: smwmusic-knuckles-chaotix-tube-panic
title: Knuckles' Chaotix - Tube Panic
description:
The theme of the lesser-known blue sphere-getting special stage from the Sonic series. Knuckles and friends run through Polyhedron Land collecting orbs in a stage that truly shows off the 32X's capabilities.

I had to sacrifice panning accuracy on those background @4s in favour of actually including both notes as a chord sample. The joys of 8 channels.
